items.fact: The public 2025 TXI release reports a 6.3 problems-per-100-vehicles improvement for smart climate controls, citing the 2025 Initial Quality Study.
items.consideration: Check whether an automation or simpler interaction solves the customer task before prescribing more controls.
items.limitation: Industry-level public release, not a BMW G60 measurement, feature usage rate, or complete licensed TXI dataset.

items.fact: The public 2025 TXI release says 93% of surveyed owners with a blind spot camera use it most of the time and 74% desire it in a future vehicle.
items.consideration: Compare use and desirability for the exact proposed assistance function, then check BMW availability and scope.
items.limitation: The released percentages refer to blind spot cameras, not adaptive cruise, BMW G60 owners, or every assistance feature.

items.fact: The public 2024 TXI release reports weak owner reception for interior gesture controls.
items.consideration: Validate a concrete customer task and observed usage before expanding gesture controls.
items.limitation: Qualitative industry summary; it gives no BMW G60 usage rate or feature-level ROI.

items.fact: Audi USA describes adaptive cruise assist plus on the 2026 A6 Sedan as available.
items.consideration: Verify exact trim, package, price and matched BMW specification before calling this a competitive gap.
items.limitation: The overview does not establish standard equipment or a trim-level package comparison.
